responsibility: This file implements the singleton Rust compilation session and the high-level frontend pipeline it orchestrates. It initializes target-derived options, the linemap, backend, and analysis mappings; validates and infers crate names; handles Rust-specific command-line options and dump settings; manages extra files and extern crates; and drives successive compilation stages such as lexing, parsing, expansion, resolution, lowering, type checking, privacy, const/unsafe checks, metadata export, and code generation for input crates.
same_name_distinction: Implements the `Session` API declared in `rust-session-manager.h`, including singleton creation, crate-name inference/validation, option handling, session initialization, and orchestration of the frontend pipeline stages. Unlike the header, this `.cc` file contains the executable control flow for a compilation session.
